title: Pause, recover and catch up an authoritative fleet arrival
description: Four independent commanders enter through actual authenticated controls. Formation establishes a fleet; a route preview becomes an acknowledged departure and authoritative arrival. Owner and other-player views show private orders and outcomes. Fixed catalogue/domain clocks are explicit harness controls. Development transport capacity and tick rules remain under review; this does not certify interrupted route-draft recovery, managed encryption or hosted scheduling.

steps.description: Open each commander's own fleet preparation. Enter two fighters and an over-capacity infantry complement before committing anything.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual capacity constraint disables formation without a command.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
Invalid input does not change canonical state or reserve forces.

steps.description: Reduce infantry to the supported twenty and inspect the ready formation.
steps.acknowledgement: Formation is enabled and focused for keyboard confirmation.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.

steps.description: Confirm formation with Enter. The authoritative receipt reserves two fighters and twenty infantry for tick one, without moving them yet.
steps.acknowledgement: The service acknowledges the formation and publishes its exact waiting complement.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
One accepted receipt and revision reserve the original forces without creating a fleet or moving the garrison.

steps.description: Reload the owner account and reopen its exact campaign's home-system fleet panel.
steps.acknowledgement: The same accepted order and reserved complement return from persistence.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
Reload adds no revision, order or effect.

steps.description: Advance the explicit domain clock once and invoke the real leased tick service. Repeat delivery must do no work; no fleet or outcome is injected.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Read the authoritative formation result and select the new fleet with the keyboard. The other commander still sees only their own forces.
steps.acknowledgement: The confirmed fleet contains two fighters and twenty infantry and can be disbanded.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
Units move from garrison to exactly one fleet; only this tick's recorded production changes empire totals.

steps.description: Open the fleet route planner with the keyboard. Range limits each leg; speed determines its travel duration.
steps.acknowledgement: The real route details gain focus and show distinct range and speed.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.

steps.description: Select the nearest displayed within-range destination through its ordinary catalogue control and read the route preview.
steps.acknowledgement: A draft leg shows catalogue distance and speed-derived duration, and enables commitment.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.
Preview adds no command or movement; exact public coordinates satisfy range independently of the speed-derived tick count.

steps.description: Add a displayed beyond-range waypoint. Inspect the range remedy before issuing any route.
steps.acknowledgement: The out-of-range leg disables Send fleet with a specific range remedy.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.
Invalid routing preserves the exact canonical forces and orders.

steps.description: Reorder the distant leg with keyboard controls, restore its position, then remove it. Return to fleets and reopen the planner to retain the valid draft.
steps.acknowledgement: The retained single-leg draft is ready for keyboard commitment.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.

steps.description: Commit the route with Enter. The authoritative acknowledgement schedules departure without moving the fleet.
steps.acknowledgement: The route receipt publishes departure tick two and the selected destination.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.
One accepted receipt and revision retain the full fleet until departure.

steps.description: Reload the exact campaign and reopen the original fleet's accepted route, without issuing a replacement command.
steps.acknowledgement: The same accepted destination and departure tick return from persistence.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.
Reload neither duplicates the route nor changes forces.

steps.description: Advance the labelled domain clock and invoke actual leased settlement. Repeat delivery must leave the full canonical state unchanged; no travel state is injected.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Read the authoritative departure and scheduled arrival. A traveling fleet cannot receive another route.
steps.acknowledgement: The fleet is traveling with a speed-derived arrival tick and disabled commitment.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.
Departure conserves the complete fleet and its original route identity.

steps.description: Pause the active campaign through development controls. The explicit harness admits pause one millisecond after departure; no fleet state is injected.
steps.acknowledgement: The authoritative pause is acknowledged and Resume is available.
verifications: The acknowledged maintenance action restores keyboard focus with the full control and outline inside every clipping ancestor.
Pause changes no units, route or production boundary.

steps.description: Deliver two concurrent overdue clock requests while paused. The real leased service must reject both without state changes; this is emulator delivery, not hosted Scheduler evidence.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Reload while paused and recover the same in-flight route from the private campaign view.
steps.acknowledgement: The pause and original arrival tick survive reload.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.
Reload cannot settle paused time or duplicate the route.

steps.description: Resume with the keyboard after a labelled one-hour maintenance interval. Paused time shifts the production boundary without advancing the route.
steps.acknowledgement: The service acknowledges Campaign resumed.
verifications: The acknowledged maintenance action restores keyboard focus with the full control and outline inside every clipping ancestor.
Exactly the recorded pause interval shifts the boundary; tick, forces and travel remain unchanged.

steps.description: Deliver the delayed arrival boundary concurrently through the real leased tick service. Sum the committed ticks, repeat delivery and compare the entire canonical state. The guarded clock changes time only, never scheduling/authorization/results.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Read the resolved arrival and resulting orbit/surface control. Landed infantry remains part of the commander's conserved forces.
steps.acknowledgement: The authoritative arrival names the destination, forces and resulting control.
verifications: The route commitment rail is visible before scrolling, and other commanders receive no private route, fleet complement or arrival report.
A single arrival retains all forces across fleet and newly controlled surface, with only actual production added.

steps.description: Return to fleet preparation, recover the destination after reload and inspect the same stationed fleet with the keyboard.
steps.acknowledgement: The recovered fleet is stationed at the destination with its surviving complement.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
Final reload preserves the exact settled state and receipt identity.
